title: veronica orchidea var. eglandulosa
intro: Veronica orchidea var. eglandulosa, commonly known as Cornish heath or Cornish fawn lily, is a plant species in the Plantaginaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties that can help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as wounds, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Veronica orchidea var. eglandulosa include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties that may aid in wound healing and skin protection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
